title: Grateful Dead Live at Rhode Island Auditorium on 1971-04-21
source: Recording Info: SBD > R > DAT >CD; Transfer Info: CD >WAV > Sound Forge 10 > TLH > FLAC; Remastered, retracked version of shnid 8227

ai_review.summary: Over‑processed soundboard tape with weird treble and untuned guitars; recording quality is poor and the performance suffers.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers criticize this April 21, 1971 show, noting a processed, harsh treble that sounds like a low‑quality MP3 and guitars that were out of tune. The soundboard source is present but the remastering has degraded the audio, and no musical highlights are mentioned.

ai_rating.rationale: Only two brief reviews, both highlighting negative aspects of sound quality and tuning; limited data leads to a low confidence rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Weird treble, over‑processed remaster that sounds like a low‑bit MP3; overall lack of clarity and harsh high frequencies.
